obligations.action_summary: Consider speed data, crash history, and roadway geometry when selecting school speed zones for camera installation.
obligations.quote: In selecting a school speed zone in which to install and operate a photo speed violation monitoring system, the city shall consider criteria including, but not limited to, the speed data, crash history, and the roadway geometry applicable to such school speed zone.

obligations.action_summary: Install signage giving notice of photo speed violation monitoring systems in use, meeting MUTCD standards.
obligations.quote: The city shall install signs giving notice that a photo speed violation monitoring system is in use to be mounted on advance warning signs notifying motor vehicle operators of such upcoming school speed zone and/or on speed limit signs applicable within such school speed zone, in conformance with standards established in the MUTCD.
obligations.law_title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Schenectady

obligations.action_summary: Have each photo speed violation monitoring system undergo an annual calibration check by an independent laboratory.

obligations.action_summary: Keep each annual certificate of calibration on file until final resolution of related liability cases.
obligations.quote: The city shall keep each such annual certificate of calibration on file until the final resolution of all cases involving a notice of liability issued during such year which were based on photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images produced by such photo speed violation monitoring system.
obligations.law_title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Schenectady

obligations.actor_raw: Operators of photo speed violation monitoring systems

obligations.law_title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Schenectady

obligations.action_summary: Have operators complete and sign a daily set-up log recording setup date, time, location, and self-test results for each system operated.
obligations.quote: Each such operator shall complete and sign a daily set-up log for each such system that the operator operates that (i) states the date and time when, and the location where, the system was set up that day, and (ii) states that such operator successfully performed, and the system passed, the self-tests of such system before producing a recorded image that day.
obligations.law_title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Schenectady

obligations.action_summary: Retain each daily set-up log until the system is permanently removed from use or final resolution of related cases.
obligations.quote: The city shall retain each such daily log until the later of the date on which the photo speed violation monitoring system to which it applies has been permanently removed from use or the final resolution of all cases involving notices of liability issued based on photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images produced by such system.
obligations.law_title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Schenectady
